name: Yakou Furio
source:
Head of the only agency in Kanai Ward, the Nocturnal Detective Agency.

An aloof and elusive man. Although not a Master Detective, he is certified by the World Detective Organization, which suggests he is an excellent detective. That said, he is somewhat weak-kneed, and his agency's policy is to stay quiet and refrain from any overt behavior that might lead to conflict with the Amaterasu Corporation Peacekeepers.

[From [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/pages/raincode/en/character]official website[/url]]
